d.d: An expression of one's own physical pain.
d.x: Ouch! You stepped on my toe! That hurt!

d.d: An expression in sympathy at another's pain.
A reply to an insult seen as savage (frequently one that is tongue-in-cheek or joking).
d.x: Ouch. How could you say that?

d.d: Something that causes discomfort or pain.
To exclaim "ouch!" in discomfort or pain.
